description: Astra-led staged coordination of 1–6 ordinary ChatGPT Extra High workers, with internal reads and webpage sends.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel Chats, bounded stages, one final goal.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate ordinary ChatGPT Extra High chats from Codex desktop, preferring 4–6 for substantial independent work. Read internally, send through the in-app browser, advance each owner independently, preserve full results, and enforce per-revision deadlines. Requires existing desktop browser and conversation capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Use $chatgpt-web-workers to delegate independent work and deliver one integrated result.
